h: UNILORIN awards a second PhD to a nurse who already holds four degrees
p: The University of Ilorin has reportedly awarded a second doctorate to a nurse who already has two bachelor's degrees and two master's degrees. The story is drawing admiration online.
more: The nurse's academic record has been widely shared.
